task.description: Hard gate on ELIXIR-DEV's implementation (commit 4efff094 on this branch, `git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex`). This closes a real security-relevant BLOCKER: a definition-promotion release could previously bypass its own mandatory rehearsal gate. Verdict per invariant, INV-1..INV-8 (or however many this repo's security-invariants.md currently enumerates), APPLIES or NOT-APPLICABLE stated for each, against the actual diff. Pay particular attention to: (1) whether the new verify_rehearsed/2 check can be bypassed by any code path that still reaches do_apply_review/3 without going through the with-chain (e.g. a second entry point); (2) whether the plan_digest comparison for the rehearsal check reuses PromotionDigest.verify_digest/2's constant-time comparison as designed, not a raw ==, since this is a security-relevant digest check; (3) whether the new 409 error responses leak any tenant-scoped or cross-tenant information beyond what the existing :invalid_transition/:digest_mismatch 409s already leak (INV-5's cross-tenant-review-id-same-response concern, already documented in promotions.ex's moduledoc, may be relevant here too); (4) that PLATFORM_ADMIN-only access to this route is unchanged by this diff.
acceptance_criteria: Every applicable invariant given a stated verdict (PASS/FAIL) against the real diff, not a general impression
Explicit verdict on whether the new gate can be bypassed by any alternate code path
Explicit verdict on whether the digest comparison used is the constant-time one
Explicit verdict on whether the new error responses introduce any new information-disclosure surface
Explicit verdict confirming route authorization (PLATFORM_ADMIN-only) is unchanged
